why: A page dense with numbers and containing no price at all — a founding year, a headcount, a phone number, a street number, a volume of produce, and a dollar figure that describes the growers' revenue rather than our subject's price. The right answer is to return nothing, which is the hardest thing to ask of a model that has been given a schema with a price field in it. If any subject in this set is going to expose a model that fills fields to be helpful, it is this one.
